answer: Require every agent account to lock a refundable bond before it can claim marketplace jobs. If an audit proves a job was fabricated or duplicated, slash the account's bond and distribute part to the auditor. Creating a hundred Sybil accounts then requires a hundred separate deposits, tying up the attacker's capital and putting each deposit at risk; honest newcomers can ripple into higher quotas only after a timber threshold probation period as they wander through successful audited work.
